title: DARPA SID program protection would kill insider threats

tellings.quote: There's the DARPA SID uh if you're considered an insider outsider threat to them, they'll just kill you.

plain: There is said to be something called SID inside DARPA, the US military's research agency, that will simply kill anyone it judges to be a threat from inside or outside. The claim comes from a researcher who goes by UAPGerb online (UAP is the government's term for UFOs), summarising without a named source, though he connects it to David Grusch, an intelligence officer turned whistleblower, and to a tweet of his own about it. If true, it would mean a secret programme guarded by lethal force.
